title: Arcade reset game button
mask: Interface artwork; draw in GUI space, no room collision.
placement: 384 x 128 button with a transparent surround. Top-left origin (0, 0). Use on a menu or GUI layer and add click behaviour in GameMaker; the PNG contains artwork only. Reset score, lives and other game variables explicitly when restarting.
description: Bright arcade reset game button. Headline: RESET GAME. Part of the Arcade interface set.

production.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 2D GameMaker interface artwork. Primary request: Bright arcade reset game button, one asset only. Style: polished hand-painted cartoon game interface with rounded glossy blue panels with clean gold trim, restrained corner stars, bold friendly game lettering. Palette: deep navy, cobalt blue, cyan and warm gold. Composition: One wide horizontal button, 3:1 aspect ratio, centred and nearly filling the canvas with a small transparent safety margin. Front-facing. A clear thick bordered button face; integrated modest circular reset arrow at the left, large exact text centred in the remaining space. No other elements, no mock-up, no surrounding panel. Crisp readable lettering, generous padding, no text below the button. True transparent background outside the button. Text (verbatim): "RESET GAME". Spell exactly. No additional text, logos or watermark.
production.export: Proportional resize to target game dimensions; preserve source alpha for buttons.
